name: SciBench-Core288
selection_goal: strong-model comparison with reduced cost; challenge-biased but not pure-hard cherry-picking
model_independence: No solver/judge correctness, score, trajectory, latency, or token usage was used to choose samples.

methodology.challenge_rule: 1 easy + 2 medium + 3 hard per task unit, based only on intrinsic chemistry/task features; label/language/diversity constraints take precedence where applicable.
methodology.knowledge_rule: 2 low-complexity + 2 mid-complexity + 2 high-complexity structurally diverse samples; no model-based notion of knowledge difficulty.
methodology.difficulty_features: task-specific intrinsic features such as molecule size/ring/heteroatom/rotatable-bond complexity, target/candidate count, threshold proximity, similarity-boundary proximity, conformer energy-gap magnitude, pharmacophore selection margin, torsion ambiguity margin, and output target multiplicity.
methodology.balance_constraints: Prefer 3 English + 3 Chinese when available; binary labels 3/3; three-way analog labels 2/2/2; diversify query groups/property focuses/structural motifs.
methodology.chemical_diversity: Within eligible tiers, maximize structural diversity using Morgan radius-2 2048-bit fingerprints; pair samples are compared in both pair orientations.
methodology.rdkit_used_for_selection: 2025.09.4 (IDs are frozen after selection; benchmark execution remains pinned to its own environment).

selection_sanity.note: Pilot overlap is reported only post hoc; pilot performance was not used in selection.

known_release_note: scibench_000687 is selected. It must only be run after the previously identified metabolic_liability public-rule/gold contract is repaired and frozen in r2; if r2 changes its semantic label rather than merely clarifying the rule, rerun this selection.
